law.result: the same instance after its class transition
law.observable_claim: Reclassify an existing instance destructively while retaining EQ/object identity, preserving values of same-name common slots, and leaving previously unbound common slots unbound.
positive_witnesses: Instance of A with common slot p=7 transitions to B; result is the identical object, CLASS-OF is B, p remains 7.
A common slot unbound before transition remains unbound after transition unless a separate initialization rule explicitly binds it.
falsifiers: Return a fresh instance instead of retaining identity.
Lose the value of a same-name common slot.
Silently bind a common slot which was unbound before transition.
law.scope_boundary: Lifecycle hooks such as UPDATE-INSTANCE-FOR-DIFFERENT-CLASS are not independent residents in this selection; D2 retains language-form/control authority.

nearest_selected: CLASS-OF is a separate pending proposal
dedup.distinction: A class-definition or construction operation does not reclassify an already existing instance while retaining its identity and common slot values.

independent_oracle.kind: SBCL ANSI Common Lisp reference oracle
